text:
anya: opened a compact PR for tool-calling docs that focuses on parsing patterns for mixed shape outputs. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5201
mike: can you call out exact SDK spots to update? we need tiny JS/Python snippets for the migration guide.
anya: yep - JS under 'parsing patterns' and Python in 'nullable-tool-outputs'. keeping examples minimal.
lina: add an explicit example normalizing single-object-or-array for both SDKs. that's the most common confusion.
anya: added this example in the thread:```js
// normalize finder response
const r = await client.callTool('finder', q);
const items = Array.isArray(r.result) ? r.result : (r.result ? [r.result] : []);
```
jorge: include a note about schema validation: recommend a `maxArrayLength` guard and failing open to a model fallback if exceeded. small snippet for the docs?
anya: added a one-liner suggestion and a short rationale.
ci-bot: lint check started for PR 5201 - examples-smoke
lina: nit - remove trailing comma in the Python sample; pushed fix.
mike: ops asks for a short sentence on caching: prefer prefix cache for stable tool chains vs re-invoking tool every call.
anya: added that + a TL;DR at the top. marking ready for review.
ci-bot: PR 5201 merged by mike - docs deploy queued
anya: thanks all. will watch for customer questions and follow up with a KB if needed.
